method: Supplement from supplied section 2 and archived public-source captures. Rendered quotes are copied literally from that section; archived-source matching normalizes HTML entities, typography and whitespace. No new source request or customer-account test was made.
limitations: Only report section 2 entries A-1 through A-8 and A-11 supply this supplement.
No source-update date established for Hosting.com; capture date is not a source-update date.
The prepaid VPS review is an individual statement; its original contract and disputed amount are not established by the quoted terms.
Cancellation notice and automatic payment dates differ; the one-day renewal deadline is not a safe charge cutoff.
A downgrade migration fee may be charged; it is not unconditional.
The material-change response window is not a universal 30-day advance renewal-price notice.
Third-party renewal-price claims and ownership assertions from A-9/A-10 were not adopted.
HostAdvice Hosting Plans prices were not used.

you will have thirty (30) days from the date of such notice to either: (i) consent to the change(s) and accept the altered terms for the Services from the date of your consent or (ii) allow the Services to be terminated after the thirty (30) day period expires.

When upgrading to a higher-priced hosting plan, we will migrate your account to the new Service at no charge. The data center migration fee is also waived if you choose to move to a new data center during the upgrade process.
If you would like to move to another data center without upgrading your account, there is a twenty-five dollar ($25) migration fee.
All complementary migrations require the user to provide cPanel account credentials for their previous hosting environment.
Clients who migrate from non cPanel hosting environments may incur a charge determined by the migration team and assessed based on the complexity of the migration.
Domain registrations, setup fees and migration fees are not refundable at any circumstance.

Refund requests of payments made to Hosting.com by bank transfer, check or money order or after one hundred twenty (120) days have passed on a credit card payment will be issued via PayPal only. If you cannot accept PayPal payments, you will not be eligible for a refund via other methods.
We will honor invoice errors as long as we are notified of them within ninety (90) days.
Any received chargebacks will incur a fifty dollar ($50) investigation fee on the associated billing account and all services will be immediately suspended pending investigation.
